about.description: Single-stock perpetual futures market on QFEX tracking Wolfspeed, Inc., quoted in USD, cross-margined in USDC and trading 24/7 with up to 10x leverage. QFEX is a hybrid central-limit-order-book exchange for traditional assets only; positions are cash-settled and confer no ownership, dividend or voting rights in the underlying. Reference prices are consumed from primary venues during the instrument's published reference-price hours and funding is zero outside them. Security caution: Wolfspeed emerged from Chapter 11 on 2025-09-29; all prior common stock was cancelled and new shares issued, and the company redomiciled from North Carolina to Delaware. Any pre-2025 CUSIP or ISIN for WOLF should not be carried forward.
